title: Peudong Keuseulamatan Nyang Teuga .
intro: Saboh tokoh nyang that saba dan keyakinan nyang hana meugoyang, ureung nyoe geujok thon-thon nyang hana teuhitong le keu misi ilahi, geuhadapi hinaan dan penolakan nyang hana putôh-putôh. Kisah awaknyan na kheueh saboh bukti nyang that teuga keuhai iman lam geuhadapi keukafiran nyang lumpah that, nyang puncak jih na kheueh saboh keujadian nyang that peunténg nyang jipeugot lom donya.
clues: Lon peukhusus masa udep lon njang luar biasa panyang untuk lon panggil umat lon untuk seumah Allah.
Umat ​​Ulôn jipeuhina Ulôn dan jitudoh Ulôn salah dan pungo nyang nyata.
Lon geuyue peugot sapeue-sapeue nyang deuh jih hana biasa keu masyarakat lon nyang hana darat.
Na padum-padum droe mantong nyang peucaya dan meugabong ngon lon dan keuluarga lon bak konstruksi nyang unik nyoe.
Lon ba pasangan-pasangan tiep-tiep makhluk udep di ateuh kapai, lagee nyang geuyue le Allah.
Banjir raya jipoh bumoe, nyang jipeuseulamat mantong ureuëng-ureuëng nyang na meusajan ulôn lam kapai ulôn, seudangkan aneuëk ulôn keudroe maté sabab hana meuiman.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
